_meta.purpose: LLM 문제 생성의 근거가 되는 커리큘럼 프레임워크. 10개 스킬 태그 × 레벨(low/mid/high) × 세부 스킬(chapter). generate_problems.js가 style/example을 프롬프트에 주입한다.
_meta.itemContract: 각 문항은 {q, c[4], a(0-based 정답 인덱스), exp} 형식. MAIN/EVID는 지문을 q 안에 임베드. 수학 문항은 선택적으로 fig(matplotlib 파이썬 코드)를 포함할 수 있고, 서버가 이를 PNG로 렌더해 docx·온라인에 표시한다.
_meta.note: 챕터가 없는 태그/레벨은 자동으로 기존 문제은행으로 폴백된다. 세부 스킬·예시가 생성 품질을 좌우하므로 신중히 유지·확장할 것.

GRAM.name: Grammar & Usage
GRAM.subject: english
GRAM.style: 한 문장짜리 문항. 빈칸(___) 채우기 또는 밑줄 오류 수정 형태. 선택지 4개는 짧은 문법 변형. exp는 적용된 규칙 이름을 명시. 문장 주제는 학술·일상·시사로 다양하게. 정답은 명백히 하나.

low.desc: 주어와 동사 사이에 전치사구가 끼어 수 일치를 흐리는 경우.
low.example: The stack of applications on the desk ___ growing daily.

low.desc: 완료된 과거 사건과 현재까지 이어지는 상태의 시제 구분.
low.example: By the time we arrived, the show ___ already begun.
The committee published ___ findings last week.

low.desc: 두 독립절을 쉼표만으로 잇는 오류 식별.
low.example: The rain stopped, we continued the game.

mid.desc: 선행사와 대명사의 수·인칭 일치, 부정대명사(each, neither) 포함.
mid.example: Each of the researchers submitted ___ own report.

mid.skill: Verb tense sequence in complex sentences
mid.desc: 종속절-주절 간 시제 일관성과 조건문 시제.
mid.example: Had the council ___ the memo earlier, the vote would have changed.

mid.desc: 목록·설명을 도입하는 콜론, 독립절을 잇는 세미콜론.
mid.example: One obstacle remained ___ funding.

mid.skill: Who vs whom / whoever vs whomever
mid.example: The grant goes to ___ the panel judges most deserving.

high.example: ___ the evidence been disclosed sooner, the case might have collapsed.

high.desc: neither...nor, along with, as well as가 만드는 수 일치 함정.
high.example: The verdict, along with the judge's remarks, ___ sealed until Monday.
The physicist Lise Meitner, a pioneer of fission, ___ denied the prize.

high.desc: 지시 대상이 모호한 대명사를 명확히 고치는 선택.
high.example: The senator briefed the governor before ___ resigned. (모호성 제거 선택)

SENT.name: Sentence Structure
SENT.subject: english
SENT.style: 문장 결합·수정·병렬·수식어 위치를 묻는 문항. 종종 원문 두 문장을 제시하고 최선의 결합/수정본을 고르게 함. 선택지는 완결된 문장. exp는 왜 정답이 문법·명료성 면에서 최선인지 설명. 정답은 명백히 하나.

low.example: Which fixes the run-on? "The tide rose quickly the crew secured the lines."
Which of the following is a complete sentence?
She spent the summer swimming, reading, and ___.

mid.desc: 수식어가 잘못된 주어를 꾸미는 오류 수정.
mid.example: Which corrects: "Dripping with cheese, Marcus served the pizza."
Combine: "The museum was closing. Dana hurried to the last exhibit."

mid.desc: not only...but also 등 상관접속사 병렬.
mid.example: The mentor was praised not only for her expertise but also ___.

high.example: Most concise: "The reason the delay happened was because of the fact that data was missing."

high.desc: 세 사건을 논리적으로 한 문장에 종속 결합.
high.example: Combine three: glacier retreated / researchers resurveyed / confirmed trend.
The report faults the agency for ignoring warnings, delaying inspections, and ___.

MAIN.name: Reading: Main Idea & Inference
MAIN.subject: english
MAIN.style: 지문을 q 안에 임베드: 형식은 Read: "<2-5문장 지문>" — <질문>. 지문은 과학·인문·사회·문학으로 다양하게. 질문은 주제/중심 생각/추론/저자 태도/수사적 기능. 선택지 4개 중 오답은 '사실이나 지엽적' 또는 '지나치게 넓음' 또는 '지문에 반함'. 정답은 명백히 하나. 지문을 c나 exp에 넣지 말 것 — 오직 q에만.

low.example: Read: "Before refrigeration, ice was harvested from lakes... The trade collapsed within a decade of the electric freezer." — What is the main idea?
Read: "Milo saved his allowance for three months... In June he bought the telescope." — What can you infer about Milo?
Read: "...Some ants build bridges with their bodies..." — The author mentions bridges in order to:

mid.example: Read: "The lab's first three grant applications were rejected for 'excessive ambition'... the fourth, narrower, was funded..." — What is the central point?
Read: "...quietly seeded the very program the earlier proposals had imagined." — The author's attitude toward the reviewers is best described as:

mid.skill: Function of a phrase within a passage
mid.example: Read: "...speed built on infrastructure beats speed built on heroism." — The phrase "speed built on heroism" refers to:

high.example: Read: "It is tempting to read the decline of letters as loss. Yet correspondence has migrated, multiplied, accelerated..." — The central claim is that:
Read: "...a clock that is right once is lucky; a model that improves with each failure is science." — Her reply implies that:
Read: "Skeptics note, fairly, that the trial was small. But its effect size was so large..." — The first sentence functions as a(n):

EVID.name: Reading: Evidence & Detail
EVID.subject: english
EVID.style: 지문을 q 안에 임베드: Read: "<정보·수치가 담긴 2-5문장 지문>" — <질문>. 질문은 명시적 세부사항 확인 또는 '어느 근거가 주장을 가장 잘 뒷받침하는가'. 데이터·연구·역사 지문 선호. 오답은 지문에 있으나 무관한 수치 또는 지문에 없는 값. 정답은 명백히 하나. 지문은 q에만.

low.example: Read: "A 2019 audit of the city's 412 bridges rated 37 as structurally deficient..." — How many bridges were rated deficient?
Read: "...officials prioritized the 12 bridges carrying the heaviest daily traffic." — Officials chose repairs based on:

mid.desc: 특정 주장을 뒷받침하는 세부 근거 선택.
mid.example: Read: "...calories fell 9% in the menu group but only 1% in the poster group..." — Which detail best supports that placement mattered?

mid.desc: 여러 수치 중 질문이 가리키는 정확한 값.
mid.example: Read: "...no single monarch completes the round trip; it takes three to four generations..." — The full round trip is completed by:

high.desc: 인과 주장을 가장 잘 뒷받침하는 설계·근거 식별.
high.example: Read: "...the groups matched in age, income, and baseline health..." — Which detail best supports that cycling itself caused the difference?
Read: "Study 1 (3,200 students, randomized)... Study 2 (45 self-selected volunteers)..." — Which study has the stronger design, and why?

VOCAB.name: Vocabulary in Context
VOCAB.subject: english
VOCAB.style: 한 문장에 밑줄 어휘를 <u>word</u>로 표시하고 'most nearly means'를 물음. 선택지는 4개의 동의어 후보(오답은 관련은 있으나 문맥에 안 맞음). exp는 문맥 단서를 짧게 설명. 정답은 명백히 하나.

low.example: The negotiations reached an <u>impasse</u>; neither side would move. "Impasse" most nearly means:
Please <u>observe</u> the fish carefully and note what you see. "Observe" most nearly means:

mid.desc: 문맥에 따라 뉘앙스가 갈리는 중급 어휘.
mid.example: The CEO's remarks were deliberately <u>equivocal</u>. "Equivocal" most nearly means:
Years of drought made the farmers <u>circumspect</u> about expanding. "Circumspect" most nearly means:

high.example: The committee offered only <u>perfunctory</u> review. "Perfunctory" most nearly means:
Once considered <u>intransigent</u>, the negotiator accepted the compromise. "Intransigent" most nearly means:

NUM.name: Number & Operations
NUM.subject: math
NUM.style: 텍스트 수학(LaTeX 금지, 거듭제곱 ^, 곱 *, 분수 a/b). 정수·분수·소수·정수론 연산. 이 영역은 보통 도형이 불필요(fig 생략). 선택지는 4개의 수치, 오답은 흔한 계산 실수를 반영. exp는 계산 단계를 한 줄로. 정답은 명백히 하나.

low.example: What is 3/4 + 2/3?

mid.example: Simplify 2^3 * 2^4.
What is the least common multiple of 6 and 8?
What is 35% of 240?

high.example: Express (3 * 10^4) * (2 * 10^3) in scientific notation.
Simplify sqrt(72).

RATIO.name: Ratio & Proportion
RATIO.subject: math
RATIO.style: 텍스트 수학. 비·비율·비례·단위환산·비례식 문장제. 보통 도형 불필요하나, 비례 관계를 그래프로 보이면 유용한 문항은 fig(matplotlib) 포함 가능. 선택지 4개 수치, 오답은 역비율·부분/전체 혼동을 반영. exp는 비례식을 한 줄로. 정답은 명백히 하나.

low.example: Express the ratio 18:24 in simplest form.
If 5 pens cost $3.50, what is the cost per pen?

mid.example: If 3 machines make 120 parts in an hour, how many parts do 5 machines make in an hour?
A map scale is 1 cm : 5 km. How many km is 7 cm?

high.example: y varies inversely with x. If y = 8 when x = 3, find y when x = 12.
A price rises 20% then falls 20%. What is the net percent change from the original?

ALG.name: Algebra
ALG.subject: math
ALG.style: 텍스트 수학. 변수는 x, y. 일차식·연립·부등식·함수·인수분해·이차식(레벨에 맞게). 직선·포물선·함수 그래프가 이해를 돕는 문항은 fig(matplotlib 좌표평면 그래프) 포함. 선택지는 수치나 식, 오답은 부호·이항 실수를 반영. exp는 풀이 단계를 한 줄로. 정답은 명백히 하나.

low.example: If 3x - 7 = 14, what is x?
If x = -2, what is 4x^2 - 3x + 1?
Simplify 5x + 3 - 2x + 8.

mid.skill: Linear equations with variables on both sides
mid.example: Solve 4x - 5 = 2x + 9.
If x + y = 10 and x - y = 4, what is x?
Solve for x: 3x + 2 > 11.

high.example: Factor x^2 - 5x + 6.
Solve x^2 - 7x + 12 = 0.
A line passes through (1, 2) and (3, 8). What is its slope?

GEO.name: Geometry
GEO.subject: math
GEO.style: 텍스트 + matplotlib 도형. 넓이·둘레·각·피타고라스·부피·좌표기하. 도형이 이해를 돕는 문항은 fig(matplotlib)로 도형을 그려 포함(삼각형·사각형·원·좌표평면 등). 필요한 치수는 문장과 도형 라벨에 명시. 선택지 4개 수치, 오답은 공식 혼동을 반영. exp는 공식과 대입을 한 줄로. 정답은 명백히 하나.

low.example: A rectangle is 8 cm by 5 cm. What is its area?

low.skill: Angles on a line & around a point
low.example: Two angles are supplementary. One is 65 degrees. What is the other?

mid.example: A circle has radius 7. What is its area? (Use pi = 22/7.)
A right triangle has legs 6 and 8. What is the hypotenuse?
A triangle has angles 40 and 75 degrees. What is the third angle?

high.example: A cylinder has radius 3 and height 10. What is its volume? (Use pi = 3.14.)
What is the distance between the points (1, 2) and (4, 6)?
Two similar triangles have a side ratio of 2:3. If the smaller has area 16, what is the larger's area?

DATA.name: Data & Word Problems
DATA.subject: math
DATA.style: 텍스트 + matplotlib 차트. 평균·중앙값·최빈값·확률·표/그래프 해석·다단계 문장제. 막대·꺾은선·산점도 등 데이터 해석 문항은 fig(matplotlib 차트)로 그래프를 포함하고 질문이 그 그래프를 참조. 선택지 4개 수치, 오답은 흔한 해석 오류를 반영. exp는 접근법을 한 줄로. 정답은 명백히 하나.

low.example: What is the mean of 4, 8, 10, 6, 12?
Sales were Mon 12, Tue 9, Wed 15, Thu 9. On which day were sales highest?

mid.example: A bag has 3 red and 5 blue marbles. What is the probability of drawing red?
A book costs $18. With a 25% discount and then $2 shipping, what is the total?

high.example: A class of 10 averages 80; a class of 20 averages 86. What is the combined average?
Two fair coins are flipped. What is the probability of getting exactly one head?
